questions.stem: When investigating factors affecting transpiration with a potometer, why is it important to allow the plant to equilibrate before taking measurements?

options.text: So the plant has time to photosynthesise
So the air bubble can dissolve in the water
So the plant can adjust to the conditions and give reliable, consistent readings
So the plant can grow new roots

questions.explanation: The plant needs time to adjust to the new conditions and reach a steady rate of water uptake. Taking measurements too soon could give unreliable results that do not reflect the true transpiration rate.
